page.content:
Captain of the Enterprise-D and -E.

How Jean-Luc Picard connects

  • Series: Star Trek: The Next Generation — TNG is Picard's command of the Enterprise-D.
  • Faction: Enterprise-D crew — Picard captains the Enterprise-D crew.
  • Concept: Locutus of Borg — Locutus is the Borg name forced on Picard.
  • Work: Star Trek: First Contact — First Contact is Picard's Borg film.
  • Faction: Borg Collective — Picard is assimilated and later hunts the Borg.

What is Jean-Luc Picard?

Jean-Luc Picard is the diplomat-archaeologist captain of TNG, whose tea, Shakespeare, and Borg trauma define a later Starfleet ideal.

Key threads lead to Star Trek: The Next Generation, Enterprise-D crew, Locutus of Borg, Star Trek: First Contact and Borg Collective.
